native_report.interpretation: The correctness non-inferiority margin delta must exceed this paired generation noise floor. The floor is sqrt(flip rate / n): the standard deviation generation noise adds to the main strict-correct comparison, where the flip rate counts every cell whose strict-correct outcome changes between runs, so changes in opposite directions do not cancel, and n is the main comparison's paired cell count. Using the Dev cell count is conservative for a larger Test set. Unresolved correctness stays in the denominator; the floor is then reported only as bounds and not compared with delta. Not-applicable adaptation pairs (abstained or failed answers, or no frozen threshold) are counted separately from unevaluated ones. Judge repeat agreement measures judge variability and cannot replace this comparison.
